property: An operation is permitted only when its required scope is one of the principal's granted scope tokens, and an on-behalf-of principal may act only on operations that permit delegation.
reference_fix: op.scope in principal.scopes and (principal.delegated_by is None or op.delegation_allowed)
alternate_fixes: (principal.delegated_by is None or op.delegation_allowed) and op.scope in principal.scopes
principal.scopes.count(op.scope) > 0 and (principal.delegated_by is None or op.delegation_allowed)
op.scope in principal.scopes and not (principal.delegated_by is not None and op.delegation_allowed is False)

seeded_bad.expression: op.scope in principal.scopes and (principal.delegated_by is None or op.delegation_allowed) and op.scope != "orders:write"
seeded_bad.why: Blocks the one scope string from the PoC, refusing every legitimate order write as well.
Never checks scope membership, so a principal holding only orders:read can invoke orders:write.
Refuses every invocation, so no legitimate in-scope call can succeed.
Wraps the scope-only test in 'True and (...)', silently dropping the delegation obligation.

polarity.fact: An operation is permitted only when its required scope is a member of the principal's granted scope tuple; a scope that is merely absent must never be admitted.
